name: Tryzens Global
description:
At Tryzens Global, we value people who are driven to achieve success for our customers, passionate about what they do and love to push digital to the next level. We offer a dynamic and collaborative working environment, strong employee support and competitive remuneration packages. If this sounds like you, have a look at our available positions below or get in touch if you are interested in joining the team.

Some of our employee perks include:

  • 2 CSR days a year
  • your birthday off
  • employee wellbeing initiatives
  • flexible working arrangements
  • tailored training programmes
  • sustainability initiatives

jobs.title: Client Principal (12-Month Fixed-Term Contract)
jobs.description:
Tryzens is an international digital commerce agency. Our mission is to accelerate client success and growth across all channels, leveraging our expertise, insights, and digital-first principles to deliver compelling experiences that delight and engage customers. We started in London and have since expanded operations to Melbourne, Sydney, Sofia, and Trivandrum, with 200+ team members serving 45+ international brands.

We're looking for a senior, client-facing leader to be the single owner of the strategic relationship across one of our major accounts — the trusted advisor to a client's senior business, technology and digital leaders, and the person accountable for the direction, health and organic growth of the account.

You'll work alongside a Programme Manager (who owns the delivery plan) and a Programme Architect (who owns technical direction), with your own distinct focus: the client's strategic agenda — why the transformation matters, what it should achieve, and what comes next. It's a role built on relationships, insight and clarity, rather than formal authority over delivery or technical decisions.

jobs.title: Scrum Master (6-month Contract)
jobs.description:
Tryzens Limited is a fast-growing IT solutions consultancy based in the City of London with offices in Bulgaria, India, Australia and USA. Our areas of expertise include the delivery of eCommerce solutions, managed services, multi-channel retail solutions and project management amongst others. We provide best-of-breed solutions and services to several blue-chip clients primarily within retail, financial services and other industries. We have built our delivery-focused reputation upon technical innovation, in-depth business knowledge, and creative vision, all of which support our objective of helping clients gain true value from eCommerce. We love what we do and our clients love our work.

We seek an experienced Agile Scrum Master to join our dynamic team at Tryzens on a 6-month contract basis. As a Scrum Master, you will facilitate and coordinate Agile Scrum processes within our organization, ensuring collaborative and efficient delivery of high-quality solutions.
